message.content:
I don’t have real‑time data built into this chat, so I can’t tell you the exact Air Quality Index (AQI) for Los Angeles at this moment.  
If you need up‑to‑date information, you can check one of the following:

| Source | How to use |
|--------|------------|
| **AirNow** (U.S. EPA) | Visit https://www.airnow.gov/, enter “Los Angeles” or your ZIP code, and you’ll see the current AQI, pollutant levels, and health recommendations. |
| **World Air Quality Index (WAQI)** | Go to https://waqi.info/, search for “Los Angeles,” and view the live AQI and trend charts. |
| **Mobile apps** | Apps like *AirVisual*, *Plume Labs: Air Report*, or *EPA AirNow* provide real‑time alerts and forecasts. |
| **Local news** | Many local stations (e.g., KABC, KTLA) report on air quality during severe pollution events. |

If you’d like a quick snapshot, you can also use a voice assistant (Google Assistant, Siri, Alexa) and ask, “What’s the air quality in Los Angeles right now?” They pull data from the same sources.
